module: Event node "on Cannon Fired" (category `repeat_instant`). Emits a pulse on the flow output `cannonFired` when the `onCannonFired` hook is received. No input.
notes: The hook's `id` parameter is not exposed on an output.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

onCannonFired.desc: Hook called when a cannon fires; raises the internal flag. `id`: vehicle/object identifier (inferred from the name, unused).

work.desc: Sets `cannonFired` to true for one frame if a shot was signaled, otherwise false.

workOnce.desc: Sets the internal flag `flag` to false.
